method: Direct source and changed-line review of the lookup, both production callers, adapter presence classification, real-terminal regressions and bounded fixture alignment.
boundaryChecks: Exact session matching remains in the existing adapter.
A missing session is created only through the existing lifecycle lease; an occupied name is not adopted.
The regression preserves the neighboring session and its pane.
Partial doubles supply their existing present-pane fixture fact; no assertion was removed or weakened.
No hardened-path, credential, native-command, public API or task-state write behavior was changed.
independentCoverage: The earlier independent review and one P0/P1 confirmation are unchanged. The later unisolated seat delta is root-reviewed, not independently reviewed.
